routes.name: Drept de şedere temporară în scop de muncă (permis unic)

note: Romania, read in Government Emergency Ordinance 194/2002 on the regime of foreigners, republished, in the consolidated form the General Inspectorate for Immigration publishes (valid 27-30 April 2026, including Emergency Ordinance 32/2026). A foreigner who enters on a long-stay visa for employment has the right of temporary residence for work extended, on a full-time contract paying at least the national minimum gross wage, for the contract's period but not more than 2 years (3 for the highly qualified), successively; the permit is the single permit, tied to the employment (work for the sponsor). After 5 years' continuous temporary residence (absences not over 6 consecutive months nor 10 in all) the foreigner may have long-term residence; the work it allows is set by Ordinance 25/2014, not read, so it is not kept as a route of its own. EU citizens' free movement (Emergency Ordinance 102/2005), fees, decision times and citizenship's years were not read.

sources.title: Ordonanţa de urgenţă nr. 194/2002 privind regimul străinilor în România, formă consolidată valabilă la 30-04-2026 (IGI)
sources.said: Formă consolidată valabilă la data 30-04-2026 ... Dreptul de şedere temporară în scop de muncă se prelungeşte în condiţiile prevăzute la alin.
